draft_key_information_units.information: Net revenue reached SEK 3,963 million in 2025, up 11.3% from SEK 3,562 million in 2024, with growth driven primarily by the Nordics segment.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Key figures table: Net revenue 3,963 (2025) vs 3,562 (2024); Revenue growth 11.3% vs 16.6%; Nordics net sales 3,699.8 (up 12.0%) accounting for 93.4% of total; CEO statement and management report confirm growth faster than market and Norway surpassing SEK 1 billion.

draft_key_information_units.information: EBIT declined to SEK 78.2 million (2.0% margin) from SEK 117.4 million (3.3% margin) in 2024; net result was SEK -3 million vs SEK 21 million, with gross margin falling to 41.9% from 44.0%.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Key figures: EBIT 78.2 (2.0%) vs 117.4 (3.3%); Gross profit 1,659 (41.9%) vs 1,569 (44.0%); Net result -3 vs 21; Management report and income statement detail the figures and segment contributions.

draft_key_information_units.information: Nordics segment (93.4% of sales) grew 12.0% to SEK 3,699.8 million with strong momentum; Europe segment sales declined 1.3% to SEK 130.7 million, prompting reorganization and office closures.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Segment reporting: Nordics net sales 3,699.8 (EBIT 368.3) vs prior; Europe 130.7 (EBIT -26.7); Management report notes reorganization in Europe with centralization from Nordic HQ; CEO statement highlights Norway >SEK 1bn.

draft_key_information_units.information: New automated warehouse expansion in Vansbro went live in 2025 (largest project ever, ~SEK 500 million investment), providing capacity for up to 100,000 orders per day and expected full operation in early 2026.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Highlights and CEO statement: 'new automated warehouse expansion in Vansbro went live, with the capacity to handle 100,000 orders per day'; 'investment of approximately SEK 500 million is the largest in the company’s history'; ramp-up noted in Q3 events and warehouse section.

draft_key_information_units.information: First Fab Store (500 m² scalable concept) opened in Täby Centrum in November 2025; additional store openings included third in Finland (Espoo) and fifth in Norway (Stavanger).
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Highlights: 'opened our very first Fab Store in Täby Centrum'; 'fifth store in Norway at Kvadrat'; 'third store in Finland in Espoo'; Selected events and growth journey detail the openings and concept as blueprint for future stores.

draft_key_information_units.information: Own brands portfolio expanded with relaunch of Make Up Store and launch of Scandinavian Soap Factory; own brands continue to grow as percentage of sales and support margin improvement.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Own brands section and highlights: 'relaunched the iconic Make Up Store'; 'new brand Scandinavian Soap Factory was launched'; CEO statement notes 'relaunch of our Make Up Store and the new brand Scandinavian Soap Factory'; history confirms prior acquisitions and 2025 developments.

draft_key_information_units.information: Cash flow from operating activities improved significantly to SEK 528 million from SEK 210 million in 2024; net debt (excl. IFRS 16) reduced to SEK 292 million from SEK 333 million.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Key figures: Cash flow from operating activities 528 vs 210; Net debt 292 vs 333; Cash flow statement and management report detail the increase driven by working capital changes and operations.

draft_key_information_units.information: Post-period events include announcement of cost savings programme expected to deliver ~SEK 100 million annual savings (affecting ~70 positions, SEK 22 million restructuring cost in Q1 2026) and extension of credit facilities to 2028.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Events after the end of the year: 'published a Trading Update... announced a cost savings programme... SEK 100m... 70 full-time positions. A SEK 22m restructuring cost...'; 'signed an extension agreement with Danske Bank and Swedbank to extend current RCFs until 2028'.

draft_key_information_units.information: Over 350,000 new customers acquired in Q4 2025 alone; strengthened brand awareness (top of mind for every other Swedish woman) and market share gains in a challenging industry environment.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO statement: 'in the fourth quarter alone we welcomed over 350,000 new customers'; 'Every other Swedish woman has Lyko top of mind'; 'continued to grow faster than the market, gain market share'; highlights and strategy sections support brand metrics.

evaluation.selection_rationale: Selected 9 units to cover headline financial performance (revenue, EBIT, margins), major changes (growth slowdown, profitability decline), segment developments, key operational milestones (automation, Fab Store, store openings), own brands strategy, liquidity/cash flow improvements, and material post-period events (cost savings, financing). Units are independently omittable, focus on material summary-level content supported directly by the source, avoid boilerplate, and align with reference salience where applicable while prioritizing financial and strategic drivers.
